title: Work Bus
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office prepares for a week-long absence with the introduction of a work bus, leading to conflicts over its purpose and humorous interactions. Jim considers a side job in Philly and discusses health concerns about EMF radiation, while the team enthusiastically plans a trip to a pie stand, culminating in group chants and celebrations.

main_threads.thread: Office preparations and conflicts over the work bus, including Jim's side job and health concerns.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: So, we will be leaving the office for one whole week.
Dwight: Roll into the future with Work Bus.
Jim: What are you talking about? You're not the boss. Andy is.
Dwight: No. No! This is a work bus. The wheels are for transporting the work space to and from the work site.

Jim: I'm gonna drive you up to the lake, give you a whole week on the water. Just you, me and the kids.
Pam: Oh, can we stop by that pie stand on the way?
Jim: You mean Laverne'...
Jim: You know he's doing all this on purpose.
